description: Add Settings.recreateReplicasOnPrimaryCrash and Settings.assistiveTroubleshootingEnabled (booleans). Cloud SQL Admin returns both in the settings of instances.get and instances.list (observed live 2026-11-13 on PostgreSQL instances), but the discovery document (revision 20261018 in the mirror, 20261107 live) lists neither, so strict response validation rejects every instance read with 'Expected a union member, got an object at ["settings"]'.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Whether Cloud SQL recreates the instance's read replicas after the primary crashes. Returned by Cloud SQL Admin but not listed in the discovery document.
Whether assistive troubleshooting is enabled for the instance. Returned by Cloud SQL Admin but not listed in the discovery document.
